pitch_en: We grow mushrooms in urban spaces using recycled organic waste. Our model creates sustainable protein, reduces waste, and connects small producers through a circular economy ecosystem.

cta_pitch_en: We transform urban organic waste into sustainable protein through oyster mushroom cultivation. Our model reduces waste, produces local food, and connects small producers in a circular economy system.
